title: 第011章 燃烧星海点亮银河至高协议第012章 最终兵器斗神 塔丽丝
slug: 领主神级词条招募原罪堕天使
lines: 随着时间的流逝，一个小时的时间过去了。
虚空试炼结束。
【叮：虚空试炼结束，正在评估.....】
【叮：评估完成，战损0，杀敌5000，评分：sss】
【叮：你获得sss级深渊难度宝箱！】
“5000？这次的虚空试炼居然有5000的怪物。”苏业看着如同小山一样堆积起来的尸体。
“果然深渊难度是乘法不是简单的加法啊。”苏业砸了砸想到了自己昨天的深渊难度，也就1000的小恶魔而已。
但是今天就是5000，而且还是四阶的兵种，这还只是自己提升一级领主之心的缘故。
不过难度越高，评分宝箱开启的东西也越好，否则自己也不可能搞到唯一级别的奇观，这玩意是属于那些神级领主都要抢破头的东西。
“分解。”苏业直接动用了自己的权柄分解领地之中的尸体。
【叮：你获得500本源结晶。】
“还不错。”苏业看着分解出来的500本源结晶，满意的点了点头，本来就是废物利用，能分解出500已经很不错了。
“神皇大人。”莉莉丝从天上飞了下来，落到了苏业的面前，身后则是一尊尊沐浴着鲜血的原罪堕天使。
苏业笑着看向莉莉丝等人：“你们先去洗漱休息一下吧，剩下的就交给我了。”
莉莉丝点了点头，带着原罪堕天使去泡澡去了，毕竟她身上到处都是血迹，自然要好好洗漱一下。
苏业看着离开的莉莉丝等人，经过一个小时的厮杀，莉莉丝的等级提升的黑铁七星，其她原罪天使也都一样，先后提升了上来。
“神级单位提升资源真是难啊。”苏业摇了摇头，不再去想兵种升级的事情，还好有灵源湖，虽然提升的慢，但是多少还是能够提升的。
苏业心念一动，怪物掉落的宝箱全部都汇聚了起来，苏业查看了一下宝箱，一共800个宝箱。
【叮：是否打开黑铁级.深渊宝箱？】
“打开。”苏业带着一丝期待的说道。
【叮：你获得金币x100】
【叮：你获得本源结晶x10】
“果然。”苏业看着黑铁级.深渊宝箱开出来的东西，还是金币和本源结晶。
其中金币获得了4w，本源结晶获得了4000，对于其他领主来说这是一笔巨款，但是对于苏业来说也就那样。
主要是目前还没地方花。
“还行吧。”苏业看向最后的评分宝箱。
【叮：是否打开sss级深渊难度评分宝箱？】
“开启。”苏业深吸了一口气，眼中带着期待的看着面前的宝箱。
三道提示音不断的响起。
【叮：你获得一阶兵营：机枪营地！】
【叮：你获得异宝奇观：酒池肉林！】
【叮：你获得唯一奇观：英灵殿！】
苏业倒吸一口凉气，看着自己开出来的东西，一座兵营，两座奇观。
“果然新手时期就是勇敢者的游戏，难怪每一次新手后期，明知道深渊难度很难，但是有些领主还是要去试试。”苏业看着自己开出来的东西脸上带着笑容。
虽然昨天开出来的东西也好，苏业还以为是新手buff的隐性福利，但是现在看来不止如此，深渊难度的虚空试炼就是有好东西。
content_en:
As time passed, an hour passed.
The Void Trial is over.
[Ding: The void trial is over and is being evaluated...]
[Ding: Evaluation completed, battle damage 0, kill 5000 enemies, score: sss]
[Ding: You get a SSS level abyss difficulty treasure chest! 】
............
"5000? There are actually 5000 monsters in this void trial." Su ye looked at the corpses piled up like a hill.
"Sure enough, the Abyss difficulty is multiplication, not simple addition." Su ye thought about his Abyss difficulty yesterday, which was only 1,000 little devils.
But today it is 5,000, and it is still a fourth-level soldier. This is just because I have upgraded my Lord's Heart to the first level.
However, the higher the difficulty, the better things you can open in the rated treasure chest. Otherwise, you would not be able to get the only level of wonders. This thing is something that all god-level lords have to fight for.
"Decompose." Su ye directly used his authority to decompose the corpses in the territory.
[Ding: You get 500 source crystals. 】
"Not bad." Su Ye looked at the decomposed 500 source crystals and nodded with satisfaction. It was originally a waste utilization, and it was already good to be able to decompose 500.
"Lord God Emperor." Lilith flew down from the sky and landed in front of Su ye. Behind her were fallen angels of original sin bathed in blood.
Su ye smiled and looked at Lilith and others: "You should go wash up and take a rest first, and leave the rest to me."
Lilith nodded and took the Original Sin Fallen Angel to take a bath. After all, there were blood stains all over her body, so she naturally needed a good wash.
Su Ye looked at Lilith and others leaving. After an hour of fighting, Lilith's level was upgraded to the Seven Black Iron Stars, as were the other Original Sin Angels, who were upgraded one after another.
"It's really difficult for a god-level unit to improve its resources." Su Ye shook his head and no longer thought about upgrading the troops. Fortunately, there was Lingyuan Lake. Although the upgrade was slow, it could still be improved to some extent.
Su ye thought, and all the treasure boxes dropped by the monsters were gathered together. Su ye checked the treasure boxes, there were 800 treasure boxes in total.
[Ding: Do you want to open the black iron level abyss treasure chest? 】
"Open." Su ye said with a hint of expectation.
[Ding: You get gold coins x100]
[Ding: You get the original crystal x10]
............
"Sure enough." Su Ye looked at the black iron level abyss treasure chest and what came out were gold coins and origin crystals.
Among them, 40,000 gold coins were obtained, and 4,000 origin crystals were obtained. For other lords, this was a huge sum of money, but for Su Ye, it was just like that.
The main reason is that there is no place to spend it yet.
"It's okay." Su ye looked at the final scoring box.
[Ding: Do you want to open the SSS level abyss difficulty rating treasure chest? 】
"Open." Su ye took a deep breath and looked at the treasure box in front of him expectantly.
Three beeps sounded continuously.
[Ding: You get the first-level barracks: the machine gun camp! 】
[Ding: You get a rare treasure: the wine pond and the meat forest! 】
[Ding: You get the only wonder: the Hall of Valor! 】
.....................
Su ye took a breath and looked at what he had driven out, a barracks and two wonders.
"Sure enough, the novice stage is a game for the brave. No wonder every novice stage, knowing that the difficulty of the abyss is difficult, some lords still want to try." Su Ye looked at what he had created with a smile on his face.
Although the things released yesterday were good, Su Ye thought they were hidden benefits of the novice buff, but now it seems that it is more than that. The Void Trial of Abyss Difficulty has good things.
